info.title: Moneykeeper Finance V2
info.description: Parallel Finance V2 supporting-context contract. It is not mounted by the default runtime before cutover.

get.description: Returns active and archived manual portfolio accounts for the authenticated owner.

post.description: Creates a manual portfolio account at version one using a required idempotency key.

get.description: Returns one tenant-owned portfolio account and its optimistic version.

patch.description: Renames a portfolio account under an expected-version fence and idempotency key.

post.description: Archives an active portfolio account while preserving immutable activity and reversals.
Restores an archived portfolio account under an expected-version fence.

get.description: Returns immutable transactions in deterministic effective-time and sequence order.
Returns manual tenant-owned security definitions without consulting an external registry.
Returns one manual instrument with explicit coupon and maturity terms.

post.description: Records an ОВДП instrument with absolute face value, currency, dates, and explicit coupon knowledge.
Records an opening, buy, sell, coupon, redemption, or correction with position-version fencing.
Appends an exact compensating fact and coordinates cancellation or reversal of optional cash settlement.

get.description: Returns exact quantity, known and unknown cost, realized result, and latest valuation state.
Returns append-only absolute price and accrued-interest observations in deterministic order.

post.description: Appends an absolute per-instrument valuation and updates only rebuildable market-value projections.

get.description: Returns the enabled currencies recognized by Reference Data, ordered by currency code. This is a side-effect-free catalog query; disabled currencies are not included.
Returns one enabled currency by its canonical three-letter uppercase code. Missing and disabled currencies are both reported as not found, and the query does not change catalog state.

post.description: Creates an active category for the authenticated user at version 1. The name is trimmed, must contain 1 to 100 characters, and must be unique among that user's active categories under case-insensitive comparison.

get.description: Returns all active and archived categories owned by the authenticated user. Archived categories remain visible so historical classifications are never hidden or deleted.

200.description: All active and archived user categories

get.description: Returns an active or archived category owned by the authenticated user. A missing category and a category owned by another user are both reported as not found.

patch.description: Changes a category name when expected_version matches its current version. A real name change increments the version; replaying the same normalized name at the current version is idempotent. Stale versions and active-name collisions return a conflict.

post.description: Makes a category unavailable for new classifications while preserving its identity and historical use. The command requires the current expected_version and increments the version on the active-to-archived transition; repeating it against an already archived category at the current version is idempotent.

Makes an archived category active and available for new classifications again without losing its history or identity. The command requires the current expected_version and increments the version on the archived-to-active transition. It conflicts when the version is stale or another active category already has the same name under case-insensitive comparison; repeating it against an already active category at the current version is idempotent.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's effective preferences. If no row has been stored, the response uses base currency UAH with version 0 and persisted false without inserting data.

patch.description: Sets the authenticated user's base currency to an enabled catalog currency using optimistic concurrency. expected_version 0 creates the first persisted preference at version 1; later changes must provide the current version and increment it on success.

post.description: Opens a tenant-owned manual account and records a non-zero opening balance through an immutable balanced journal. Requires Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Lists the authenticated user's visible active and archived accounts with exact signed and display balances.
Returns one tenant-owned account; another user's identity is indistinguishable from a missing account.

patch.description: Renames account metadata using expected_version and an Idempotency-Key without changing its currency or accounting facts.

post.description: Archives an account at expected_version while preserving its full balance and immutable journal history.
Restores an archived account at expected_version without rewriting any historical accounting facts.

get.description: Lists immutable journal details with stable occurred-at and ledger-sequence cursor ordering.

post.description: Records positive catalog-validated Money through the closed manual income or expense journal recipe.

get.description: Lists tenant journal facts with stable reverse chronological cursor pagination.
Returns immutable postings, source, relations, timing, sequence, and annotation version for one tenant journal.

patch.description: Updates mutable transaction metadata at expected_version while keeping the journal and postings immutable.

post.description: Creates exactly one immutable inverse journal linked to the original; the original is never modified.
Atomically records an exact reversal and a controlled corrected manual transaction linked to the original.
Atomically posts a same-currency or FX transfer, optional fee, exact implied rate, and all clearing legs.
Posts the explicit delta to an observed target display balance under a balance-version fence; zero deltas are rejected.

get.description: Lists provider-neutral balance observations and their immutable decision state for the authenticated tenant.
Returns one tenant case including provider values, captured Ledger balance and version, delta, and status.

post.description: Posts a visible correction only when both case expected_version and captured expected_balance_version still match.
Dismisses one pending case at expected_version without creating any journal or changing a balance.
Accepts a Monobank token for encrypted validation and resource discovery without returning the secret.

get.description: Lists provider connections and lifecycle versions for the authenticated tenant.
Returns one tenant-scoped provider connection without credential material.

post.description: Disconnects a connection under an optimistic connection-version fence while retaining history.
Encrypts a replacement provider token and advances its generation under a version fence.
Creates a new high-entropy callback credential and invalidates the previous lookup digest.

get.description: Lists external provider resources and their mapping state for one tenant connection.

post.description: Binds a discovered resource to a compatible Ledger account or creates a provider-observed account.
Ends an active mapping under a resource-version fence without deleting mapping history.
Deactivates the current mapping and establishes a versioned replacement.
Creates an idempotent durable sync job for a bounded statement interval.

get.description: Returns durable progress and fencing state for one tenant sync job.
Returns one immutable revision-aware provider transaction fact.
Returns retry and completion state for the provider-event import process.
Returns a durable provider balance observation and its comparability decision.

post.description: Persists encrypted single-use OAuth state and returns the provider redirect.

get.description: Consumes durable single-use OAuth state and redirects to its recorded terminal result.
Returns the authenticated user's email connections without triggering synchronization.
Returns durable connection and synchronization status without triggering work.

post.description: Fences existing credential and synchronization generations with optimistic concurrency.
Creates an idempotent durable generation-fenced synchronization job.

get.description: Returns the tenant's recurring subscription inventory.
Returns one recurring subscription and its current optimistic version.

patch.description: Changes subscription lifecycle or forecast metadata using expected_version.

get.description: Returns immutable charge evidence and matching versions for a subscription.
Returns expected recurring charges without posting money.

post.description: Appends a version-fenced match with one or more exact Ledger journal allocations.
Appends a version-fenced rejection fact without deleting evidence.
Appends a once-only unmatch and starts version-checked annotation compensation.

get.description: Selects an immutable direct or inverted external rate as of the requested timestamp.
Reads the rebuildable balance history projection for a date range.
Reads financial cash inflow and outflow projections excluding transfers and controls.
Reads categorized expense projections for a date range.
Reads liability account balances with their financial display signs.
Reads the monotonic reconciliation lifecycle projection.
Reads recurring charge totals from public event-fed projections.
Reads assets, liabilities, and available portfolio valuations without double counting cash.
Returns borrowed and lent agreements with confirmed component balances and accounting status.

post.description: Creates immutable contractual terms and queues Ledger liability or receivable account provisioning.

get.description: Returns one tenant-owned agreement and its confirmed outstanding components.
Returns the immutable contractual revision history in revision order.

post.description: Appends a version-fenced term revision without changing posted accounting.

get.description: Returns immutable monetary intent and accounting history for an agreement.
Returns one movement with separated principal, accrued interest, current interest, and fee components.

post.description: Closes a version-fenced agreement only when all confirmed components are zero and no process is pending.
Queues an exact principal balance-sheet transfer for durable Ledger accounting.
Queues explicit principal, accrued interest, current interest, and fee allocations without guessing.
Queues a manual interest or contractual fee accrual without creating an amortization schedule.
Queues a reasoned principal, interest, or fee write-off with direction-specific classification.
Queues a once-only Ledger reversal before applying exact inverse confirmed component effects.
Starts a durable reverse-then-post replacement saga while preserving every original fact.
Creates a user-owned external person for future shared bills; the contact is never an application identity.

get.description: Lists active contacts and optionally archived contacts while preserving historical identity.
Returns one tenant-owned active or archived contact.

patch.description: Updates contact metadata with optimistic concurrency and idempotent replay.

post.description: Prevents selection for new bills without hiding historical bill facts.
Persists exact resolved shares and deterministic obligations, then starts durable accounting.

get.description: Lists current and historical shared-bill positions for the authenticated user.
Returns resolved allocation facts, obligations, settlements, and observable process status.

post.description: Appends immutable replacement facts after active settlements have been reversed.
Records a manual, imported-journal, or external settlement without classifying it as income or expense.
Appends a visible once-only reversal before a bill may be revised or cancelled.

post.summary: Cancel and reverse a shared bill
post.description: Starts durable reversal of active bill accounting and never deletes bill history.
